description: Removes hidden metadata from photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC), videos (MP4, MOV), PDFs and camera RAW files (CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, DNG, RAF, RW2, ORF, PEF): GPS location, camera and serial numbers, owner and author names, dates, XMP/IPTC, C2PA Content Credentials and AI prompts. Works on files or folders on this computer. Originals are not changed: a clean copy is saved as name-clean.ext unless in_place is true. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

in_place.description: Overwrite the originals. Only use when the user explicitly asks for it.

keep_dates.description: RAW files: keep the capture date.

mode.description: Images: all = remove everything (default); ai = only AI tags, C2PA and prompts, keep camera data; gps = only location; c2pa = only Content Credentials. Videos support all and gps.

output_dir.description: Folder to save clean copies in. Default: next to each original.

paths.description: Absolute paths of files or folders to clean

recursive.description: Include sub-folders when a folder is given.

name: clean_files
title: Remove metadata from files
